name: BackupCreationV1
snapshot: request LLD-01 consistent backup snapshot while authoritative DB uses verified SQLCipher connection
snapshot descriptor freezes source data_instance_id/schema/migration identity and SHA-256
copy snapshot plus exact source 32-byte live DEK only into protected in-process backup packaging context; live DEK is never written plaintext to staging metadata
keying: generate independent random 32-byte backup key for every backup
portable: generate independent 20-byte random recovery secret; derive 32-byte KEK with HKDF-SHA256 using public random 32-byte salt and info SOMA-BACKUP-PORTABLE-KEK-V1

portable: independently derive 32-byte detached-auth key from the same recovery secret and public salt using HKDF-SHA256 info SOMA-BACKUP-PORTABLE-AUTH-V1; KEK and authenticity key are domain-separated and never reused
managed: unwrap independent installation managed-backup-root secret from DPAPI; derive per-backup KEK with HKDF-SHA256 using public salt and info SOMA-BACKUP-MANAGED-KEK-V1
wrap random backup key using AES-256-GCM-SIV with random 12-byte nonce and canonical public-header AAD
payload: build encrypted key record containing live DEK + source data-instance identity; encrypt under backup key
stream snapshot in 4 MiB chunks; each chunk gets independently random 12-byte nonce and AAD=(header_digest,index,plaintext_length,record_kind)
build encrypted internal manifest containing snapshot/payload digests, schema/migration/app identity and bounded file inventory
managed mode writes the governed managed artifact temporary output according to its catalog contract
portable mode creates one same-parent temporary SOMA_PORTABLE_BACKUP_SET_V1 directory and writes encrypted payload as payload.somabackup
portable mode computes exact payload byte length, payload SHA-256 and authenticated public-header SHA-256, then writes canonical SOMA_PORTABLE_BACKUP_MANIFEST_V1 manifest.json
portable mode computes HMAC-SHA-256 over the exact canonical manifest bytes using the domain-separated authenticity key and writes SOMA_PORTABLE_BACKUP_AUTH_V1 auth.json
self_verify: portable: require exactly payload.somabackup, manifest.json and auth.json in the temporary set and reject missing/duplicate/unexpected/reparse members

portable: parse canonical manifest with unknown/duplicate fields rejected, recompute manifest SHA-256, derive detached-auth key, verify auth tag in constant time, then verify payload size/SHA-256/header binding before payload decryption
derive/unwrap payload key using the just-created recovery secret or managed root path
authenticate/decrypt every payload record and recompute all lengths/digests
extract into isolated verification directory and invoke LLD-01 verify_restored_database with recovered live DEK
portable: only after complete-set authenticity + payload cryptography + database/schema/audit integrity success atomically rename the temporary set directory to final *.somabackupset destination
managed: publish only after its existing full cryptographic/database verification succeeds
only after the governed final output is published record completed catalog/audit/result evidence
portable_secret: portable recovery secret is returned/displayed exactly once outside the set; SOMA never persists the secret, KEK or detached-auth key
failure: temporary set/artifact and verification files removed best-effort; no success/catalog verified state; no existing backup pruned; portable mode never degrades to payload-only success when either detached companion is unavailable or invalid
rules: outer backup AEAD is independent of SQLCipher live encryption
including live DEK only inside backup-key-encrypted payload makes portable restore possible without tying backup recovery to source Windows DPAPI
detached HMAC authenticity is independent from payload-key wrapping by HKDF domain separation
payload digest alone never establishes portable-set authenticity
portable publication is directory-atomic so an interrupted creation cannot expose a successful partial set
